address: B1-06, Mix 6, 686 South Xizang Road, Huangpu, Shanghai, China Mainland
bio: A household name in Huangpu district, this place has been around for 10-plus years. Regulars keep flocking to its new shop since it moved into a shopping mall. Open in the morning only, it always attracts a queue of customers coming for a hearty meal. With their juicy, generous pork filling, Shanghai classic potstickers are a must-try. Cabbage rice with sausage and salted pork is another hit, each grain of rice enrobed in creamy lard....
